foundation:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI skin sprite atlas for Pipa Klub, paper-and-bamboo kite creature game. Input reference image: existing game's UI atlas; use ONLY as style reference, not as layout or background. Create a NEW precisely organized 4 columns by 4 rows atlas, square 1536x1536 canvas, each imaginary cell 384x384 pixels, with generous transparent separation. Actual transparent background, no painted backdrop. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, labels, grid or guide marks.
Style: polished hand-painted 2D anime RPG interface, warm ivory washi paper with very subtle grain, honey bamboo thin edges, deep teal bindings, burnt-orange kite-paper accents, tied string knots. Crisp clean dark outlines, readable simplified forms, charming crafted aesthetic matching reference. Avoid bulky decoration, filigree, gradients behind objects, outer glows or shadows outside assets. All objects straight-on, no perspective. Every asset fully contained and centered in its own equal square cell.
ROW 1: four horizontal pill/rounded rectangle button skins ALL same size 320px wide x104px high, small bamboo caps and tiny tied string detail at corners, completely blank uncluttered center: column1 vivid burnt-orange primary with dark outline; column2 warm ivory secondary with bamboo border teal corner bindings; column3 brick red destructive with dark bamboo border; column4 muted stone-paper disabled. Straight horizontal top and bottom central edges make these useful as left-cap / stretchable middle / right-cap.
ROW 2: column1 large ivory window 320x280 with restrained bamboo corners and thin teal outer border, long straight edges; column2 portrait card frame 256x280 ivory paper center with narrow teal border and little orange kite diamond only at top-left corner; column3 SELECTED horizontal tab 320x104 warm ivory and teal edging, orange tiny bottom-center indicator; column4 UNSELECTED horizontal tab same geometry muted sage paper and thin bamboo edging.
ROW 3: column1 circular ivory action button 240x240 with thin concentric bamboo and teal outer ring and perfectly blank center; column2 circular muted teal action button SAME size and geometry, blank center, gold thin rim; column3 ivory speech balloon 320x160 with bamboo border and small downward triangular tail at bottom-left; column4 horizontal teal header/nameplate 320x104 bamboo edge and a tiny orange kite ornament at left only, empty center.
ROW 4: column1 horizontal command footer panel 320x104, dark teal paper with bamboo top and bottom thin edges and simple endcaps; column2 horizontal resource chip 280x104 ivory with bamboo border and tiny teal bindings; column3 square ivory input-cell frame 160x160 with teal bamboo trim and blank center; column4 ivory compact tooltip window 320x160, slim bamboo border, teal corner bindings, without speech pointer.
Important every painted object has alpha-transparent exterior. Do not fill empty cells or draw checkered transparency. Use full canvas correct 4x4 registration, never merge cells. This is a texture atlas not a poster or UI screenshot.

icons:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: nine illustrated pictograms in a production sprite atlas for Pipa Klub. Reference: existing paper-and-bamboo game interface, use only its warm painted 2D anime RPG material language. NEW square atlas, perfectly equal 3 columns x3 rows, each asset centered in its own imaginary square cell. TRANSPARENT background. Important: every object occupies at most 65% of its cell width and height, leave broad transparent padding between every asset and outside sheet. No frames around cells, no grid lines, no text, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no watermarks.
Art: simplified expressive readable game pictograms, crisp dark teal outlines, warm ivory paper, honey bamboo, orange vermilion kite-paper, gold cord fittings, teal fabric details. Limited forms and subtle painted shading, visible silhouettes. Face-on icons, no scenic backgrounds, no globes behind icons, no heavy glow, no floating decorative clutter. Clean alpha edges.
ROW1 menu icons: column1 PLAY: orange traditional diamond kite with bamboo cross spars, short knotted tail, two teal wind strokes; column2 PARTNERS: friendly cream origami paw medallion with purple folded-paper toe pads and one tiny tied ribbon; column3 PIPA DEX: open cream field-guide book, teal cover, visible tiny kite silhouette on blank pages, orange bookmark.
ROW2 menu icons: column1 CLUB: two bamboo kite-line spools crossed as a friendly club crest with short teal ribbon; column2 SCHOOL: small dark teal bamboo-framed teaching board with one simple orange kite drawing, no text; column3 OPTIONS: broad 8-tooth honey-bamboo gear with teal center cord knot.
ROW3 simplified battle icons designed to fit in small circles, NO circle frames: column1 LINE MANEUVER: one short ivory cord pulled taut around tiny bamboo spool, a single bold orange angular downward-then-up arrow, strong simple silhouette; column2 PARTNER SKILL: one bold teal and gold four-point kite-shaped energy spark with orange center, no complicated filigree; column3 DODGE: small ivory orange kite shifting sideways with two curved teal motion strokes.
